meta.title: Little River County — the money trail
meta.note: This is the county's 2026 budget as filed with the state: appropriation ordinance O-2025-18 (passed November 10, 2025) and the line-item budget it adopts. Fund and office amounts are the ordinance's "TOTAL BUDGET" figures; category amounts are the budget pages' 2026 column, which matches them. The county moves money between its own funds (for example $1,832,100.00 from County Sales Tax and $850,000.00 from the Sales Tax Bond fund), so some dollars appear in two funds.

nodes.name: Corona Virus Relief
nodes.note: The ordinance (p. 6) lists this fund as "transfer as needed" with no TOTAL BUDGET line; this amount is from the budget pages, where it is listed "to be transferred as needed" and is part of the $15,320,272.22 overall total.
